title: PACHA_Backdoor_Investigation_0c6
description: Investigate and respond to the PACHA backdoor malware detected in your network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The PACHA backdoor malware has been detected in your network. This malware is known to infect Linux servers and deploy coinminers. It uses various scripts to download and execute payloads from different URLs. The malware also includes iptables rules and other network activity indicators. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident. By the end of this training, you will be able to identify suspicious services, determine persistence mechanisms, and identify lateral movement scripts. Throughout this training, you will be looking for specific flags to progress through each task.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the `target` host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can access other hosts in the network. To progress to the next level, enter the word 'start'.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the `target` host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can access other hosts in the network. To progress to the next level, enter the word 'start'.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service running on the `target` host. Look for the suspicious service flag.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are not part of the standard system services. Use the command: systemctl list-units --type=service

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot. Look for the persistence mechanism flag.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for mechanisms that ensure the service starts automatically after a reboot. Use the command: systemctl list-timers

levels.title: Identify Lateral Movement Script
levels.content: Identify file transfers or remote execution used to move between hosts. Look for the lateral movement script flag.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for scripts that facilitate the transfer of files or execution of commands between hosts. Use the command: ls /usr/local/bin/
